svg.aria-label: Council debate: five members vote no on online payments at launch, the skeptic finds a gap in round 2, the moderator rejects the motion and asks six questions for the client

g.text: You
Lucia (you)
/council:vote Should the bakery launch with online payments or pay at pickup?
Context comes from ~/knowledge: 70 pre-orders a week, 6 % no-shows, budget about 3 000 €.
optimist
Pay at pickup. Launching on time is worth more than payments.
With payments and English the build is about 4 400 €, far over her budget.
NO 72
skeptic
Payments put the deadline at risk to fix a 93 € a week problem.
NO 75
client (playing Jana)
A deposit only for cakes sounds right to me.
Refunds scare me more than the fees do.
NO 70
skeptic · round 2
We all missed it: the cake deposit is taken in the shop.
Cakes ordered online would skip it, right before Christmas.
NO 70
moderator
Launch with pay at pickup; quote cake deposits as an option.
Six claims failed the evidence check, e.g. the card fee is 0.46 €, not 0.30 €.
REJECTED 0/5
council · asks you
Before you quote, ask Jana six questions.
Is the 3 000 € with or without VAT? When do texts and photos arrive?
How many cakes were never picked up last December?
